title: OPERA: OPamp Design by an Expert-Taught Reasoning Agent, from Specifications to Layout
abstract: arXiv:2610.39395v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Analog flows from specifications to a signed-off layout rarely run without manual iteration. Recent large language model (LLM) agents size circuits with optimizer loops over the device dimensions and stop at the schematic. We present OPERA (OPamp design by an Expert-taught Reasoning Agent), in which a general-purpose LLM agent designs CMOS opamps from specifications to post-layout sign-off with open-source tools. First, the designer teaches the agent the gm/ID method: map the specifications to transconductances and minimum currents, choose gm/ID per device role from characterized lookup tables, and size from equations, leaving a few knobs to search and an explainable design. Second, the agent learns the gLayout framework and taught layout practice, and writes a reusable layout generator that closes the layout and extraction loop at designer-approved gates. translated_title: OPERA：由专家传授知识的推理智能体完成运算放大器设计——从规格说明到版图
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.39395v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：从规格说明到最终签署版图的模拟电路设计流程很少能在没有人工迭代的情况下顺利完成。近期的大语言模型（LLM）智能体通过在器件尺寸上进行优化器循环来完成电路尺寸设计，并止步于原理图阶段。我们提出了OPERA（由专家传授知识的推理智能体完成运算放大器设计），其中通用LLM智能体借助开源工具，将CMOS运算放大器从规格说明一直设计到版图后签署确认。首先，设计者向智能体传授gm/ID设计方法：将规格映射为跨导和最小电流，从经过表征的查找表中为每个器件角色选择gm/ID，并根据公式确定器件尺寸，只留下少数几个旋钮供搜索，从而得到可解释的设计。其次，智能体学习gLayout框架以及所传授的版图设计实践，并编写了可复用的版图生成器，在设计者批准的关口处闭合版图与提取的循环。在SKY130工艺中，该智能体设计了一个共享的恒定gm偏置电路和六个运算放大器（五管、折叠……
tldr: 该论文提出OPERA，一个由专家传授gm/ID尺寸设计方法与gLayout版图实践的大语言模型智能体，能够使用开源工具将CMOS运算放大器从规格说明一路设计到版图后签署确认，并在SKY130工艺中成功设计了共享恒定gm偏置电路和六个运算放大器。
en_tdlr: OPERA is a general-purpose LLM agent taught the expert gm/ID sizing methodology and gLayout-based layout practice, which designs CMOS opamps from specifications all the way to post-layout sign-off using open-source tools, demonstrated in SKY130 with a shared constant-gm bias and six opamps.
